issue.title: Add dark mode support
issue.body:
## Feature Request

Many users have requested dark mode support for better accessibility and reduced eye strain.

## Proposed Solution
- Add theme toggle in settings
- Implement CSS variables for theming
- Persist user preference in localStorage
- Support system preference detection

## Benefits
- Improved accessibility
- Better user experience
- Modern UI standard

## Additional Context
This has been requested by 50+ users in various discussions.
